theorems.name: Submission.lgc_support_closest_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ρ : ℝ) (ζ : Amb n ℓ), (0 : Amb n ℓ) ∈ V.support → closedBall (0 : Amb n ℓ) ρ ⊆ U → ‖ζ‖ + infDist ζ V.support ≤ ρ → ∃ y ∈ V.support, dist y ζ = infDist ζ V.support ∧ V.weight (ball ζ (infDist ζ V.support)) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
